title: Desert Road
subtitle: Linear: the list order is the progression
description: Six stops out and six stops back, and every one of them named. The nodes are
placed to walk left to right along the top row, turn at the oasis, and come
home along the row below -- so the canvas draws the journey the list
describes, which is the whole point of naming the order instead of declaring
The theme is copper, and it is the chapter's own: it covers this canvas and
the quest panel, and stops at the sidebar beside it, which keeps whatever
theme you chose for the book.
Walk it with /tasked complete if you want to watch the road fill in. The
gathering is real, and the road is not going anywhere.
